query:
UPDATE cards c
INNER JOIN dataSources ds ON c.id = ds.cardId
SET c.snkrdunkId = SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(ds.sourceUrl, '/apparels/', -1), '/', 1)
WHERE ds.source = 'snkrdunk' 
AND ds.sourceUrl LIKE '%/apparels/%'
AND c.snkrdunkId IS NULL;
